load_experiment_from_directory: load a trained HoloDiffusion experiment from an experiment directory with optional render size and device overrides
load_experiment_with_sequence_filter: load a HoloDiffusion experiment restricted to a specific sequence name from the experiment directory
load_experiment_with_custom_render_size: load a HoloDiffusion experiment with custom render image width and height dimensions
get_config_from_experiment_directory: load and return the OmegaConf DictConfig from an expconfig.yaml file in an experiment directory
review_load_experiment_function: review the load_experiment function to understand how it merges configs and reconstructs the model and data source
